name: TU Dresden
quoteForeigners: On these pages, you will find specific information for international applicants and students.
quoteMoney: In addition to semester contribution, some students are obliged to pay tuition fees, pursuant to article 13 of the Saxon Higher Education Act ( Sächsisches Hochschulgesetz - SächsHSG ).
notes: Обучения нет: в обычном случае только семестровый взнос, плата бывает за второе высшее, дистанционку и перебор семестров. Бакалавриат в основном на немецком.

name: Brno University of Technology
quoteForeigners: The programmes are open to applicants from all countries, however you might need a visa to stay in the Czech Republic.
quoteMoney: As an international student, you can study in Czech language for free.
notes: На чешском бесплатно для иностранцев, но нужно знание чешского (вуз предлагает годовой курс). Программы на английском платные.

name: Mendel University in Brno
quoteForeigners: Provide certified documents: certified copies of original certificates and transcript of records, proof of English proficiency, copy of passport.
quoteMoney: All degree programmes taught in Czech and completed within the standard length of study are free of charge for all accepted students.
notes: Бесплатно на чешском, если сдать вступительный экзамен по чешскому; на английском платно, сумма указана в анкете.

name: Technical University of Liberec
quoteForeigners: International students can apply to study in almost 120 programmes and specializations which are carried out in the Czech language
quoteMoney: The fees in these programmes are sponsored by the Czech government, which means that students don't pay any tuition fees.
notes: Почти 120 программ на чешском бесплатны для иностранцев — платит государство; нужен чешский от B2. Английские программы 4 000–5 000 долларов в год.

name: University of Miskolc
quoteForeigners: Step 1 Choose your study programme Undergraduate programmes Graduate Programmes Doctoral programmes Double Degree Programmes English Foundation Programme
quoteMoney: Benefits for scholarship holders no tuition fee monthly stipend: for bachelor and master students HUF 43 700/ month, for PhD students HUF 140 000 /month for the first two years, and HUF 180 000 /month in the second two years after the complex exam 40 000 HUF/month worth of accommodation allowance medical insurance
notes: Стипендия Stipendium Hungaricum: без платы за обучение, месячная стипендия, жильё и страховка; нужна номинация от своей страны. Набор и на бакалавриат, и на магистратуру.

name: Budapest University of Economics and Business
quoteForeigners: You can apply for the following BA/BSc programmes at BGE: Business Administration and Management (Hungarian, English)
quoteMoney: The scholarship covers: Full tuition fees throughout your studies Monthly stipend Housing allowance Private medical insurance and access to public healthcare
notes: Stipendium Hungaricum покрывает обучение, стипендию, жильё и страховку, но нужна номинация министерства. Без стипендии английский бакалавриат — 3 000 евро за семестр.

name: Wrocław University of Science and Technology
quoteForeigners: Stay up to date with the most important information about admissions, deadlines, and events related to studies for international applicants.
quoteMoney: Scholarship of Polish Government Available for students who want to pursue studies in Polish or English, also in an option with one-year preparatory language course prior to the degree programme studies.
notes: Стипендия польского правительства (NAWA) — на учёбу на польском или английском, есть годовой языковой курс. Отдельно вуз пишет, что обучение на польском бесплатно для обладателей сертификата C1; англопрограммы платные.

name: AGH University of Krakow
quoteForeigners: Academic year 2026/2027 full-time studies in English part-time studies in English
quoteMoney: If you are qualified for studies and you have a decision of the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) , a decision of the minister or a letter from NAWA - your financial conditions at the AGH University will be determined in accordance with this decision (e.g. exemption from tuition fees).
notes: Английские программы платные (2 000–3 000 евро за семестр), но решение NAWA освобождает от оплаты. Обучение на польском бесплатно при сертификате C1.

name: Taibah University
quoteForeigners: Taibah University offers academic programs in a wide range of disciplines, allowing international students to choose the path that suits their academic and professional ambitions.
quoteMoney: Committing to pay tuition fees before the start of each semester. Paying the administrative fees before issuing the university number, which amounts to (250) riyals, excluding VAT.
notes: Внешняя «стипендия» для нерезидентов — платная: нужен финансовый гарант, медстраховка и оплата обучения каждый семестр. Сумм обучения на странице нет, назван только админ. сбор 250 риалов.

name: Ajman University
quoteForeigners: For International Students: Official secondary school certificate/transcripts certified by the authorized educational authority in the country of origin, the country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the UAE Embassy.
quoteMoney: Students admitted to any college, except the College of Medicine and College of Dentistry, who achieve a high school score of 90% or higher are eligible for a 20% tuition discount in their first semester of enrollment (Fall or Spring only).
notes: Скидка 20% за школьный средний 90%+ (30% за 99%+) в первом семестре, без привязки к гражданству; стипендия для жителей эмирата Аджман — только своим. Иностранцу нужны аттестация документов и UAE equivalency.

name: American University in Dubai (AUD)
quoteForeigners: High school diplomas and grade 12 transcripts obtained abroad must be attested by: 1. Ministry of Education of home country 2. Ministry of Foreign Affairs of home country 3. U.A.E. Embassy in home country
quoteMoney: Open to all nationalities Open to all undergraduate programs Coverage/Renewal The Scholarship entitles the recipient to a partial/full tuition waiver subject to the approval of the Scholarship Committee.
notes: Стипендия им. шейха Мохаммеда: открыта для всех национальностей, частичное или полное покрытие обучения при среднем балле 90%+. Университет платный, суммы обучения в снимок не попали.

name: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST)
quoteForeigners: Bachelor's / Post-Diploma / Pre-Master Degree Programs COLLEGES Rate per credit (Qatar Residents) Rate per credit (international Students)
quoteMoney: Rate per credit (Qatar Residents) Rate per credit (international Students) Business Management 975 QAR 1,463 QAR
notes: Иностранцы на бакалавриате платят за кредит больше резидентов: 1,463 QAR против 975 QAR. Стипендий для иностранцев на снимке нет — раздел стипендий отдельный и в снимок не вошёл.

name: American University of Kuwait (AUK)
quoteForeigners: International Students An international student is a student who is applying from outside Kuwait or you don't hold Kuwaiti residency.
quoteMoney: A competitive, merit-based scholarship awarded to top-performing students. Eligibility: First-Time College Students: Minimum 3.75 high school GPA
notes: Академическая стипендия по школьному GPA 3.75+ — гражданство в условиях не названо; государственные стипендии PUC отдельно оговорены только для кувейтцев. Размер скидки на странице не указан, плата за обучение не приведена.
